target.title: fix #99163: harden large chat attachment parsing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pasting a roughly 2 MB PNG screenshot into Control UI webchat can send a multi-megabyte `data:image/png;base64,...` attachment through Gateway `chat.send`. The Gateway attachment parser then validates and sniffs that base64 payload before delivery. On current main, the shared base64 canonicalizer builds large intermediate strings in a stack-prone shape, and MIME sniffing decodes more payload than the image signature needs.

For the reported `#99163` path, this can surface as `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` during `chat.send attachment parse/stage`, blocking the screenshot from reaching chat.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix belongs in the shared media/Gateway parsing layer, not only in Control UI, because the same canonicalization and MIME sniff helpers are used by other attachment and image paths.

This PR keeps the existing validation contract while making the hot path stack-safe:

- replace chat attachment base64 validation regex usage with an iterative scanner
- move stack-safe large-payload canonicalization into `packages/media-core/src/base64.ts`
- keep full malformed-tail validation for shared callers
- decode only a small, already-validated base64 prefix for MIME sniffing
- add Gateway, media-core, MIME-sniffer, and real Control UI browser E2E coverage

Fixes #99163.

## Root Cause

Large clipboard image payloads create base64 strings with millions of characters. The previous canonicalization path built the cleaned payload as one growing string. Downstream operations such as slicing or decoding could force V8 to flatten a deep cons-string tree and overflow the stack.

The affected path is:

```text
Control UI paste/send
  -> Gateway chat.send
    -> parseMessageWithAttachments
      -> sniffMimeFromBase64
        -> canonicalizeBase64
        -> Buffer.from(..., "base64") / prefix sniffing
```

The patch makes canonicalization chunked and iterative, then keeps MIME sniffing bounded to the image signature prefix after full-payload validation.

## User Impact

Users can paste/send large screenshot-like PNG attachments through Control UI webchat without Gateway throwing `RangeError`.

No API shape, persisted schema, config, provider routing, workflow, dependency, permission, or credential behavior changes. Small and normal attachments keep the same behavior; invalid base64 tails are still rejected.

## Evidence

### Real Control UI browser proof

Added `ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-large-paste-99213.e2e.test.ts`.

The test starts mocked Gateway + Vite Control UI, opens `/chat` in Chrome, writes a generated valid ~1.9 MB PNG data URL to the browser clipboard, presses paste in the real chat composer, waits for the attachment preview, clicks the real `Send message` button, and asserts mocked Gateway receives `chat.send` with one `image/png` attachment whose base64 exactly matches the pasted payload.

Proof summary:

```json
{
  "pngBytes": 1901669,
  "base64Chars": 2535560,
  "dataUrlChars": 2535582,
  "screenshots": [
    ".artifacts/control-ui-e2e/chat-large-paste-99213/01-pasted-large-image.png",
    ".artifacts/control-ui-e2e/chat-large-paste-99213/02-sent-large-image.png"
  ],
  "videos": [
    ".artifacts/control-ui-e2e/chat-large-paste-99213/large-paste.webm"
  ]
}
```

Validation command:

```text
PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-large-paste-99213.e2e.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

Result: 1 passed.

### Real Gateway parser proof

Generated a valid 745x745 PNG, wrapped it as `data:image/png;base64,...`, and passed it through `parseMessageWithAttachments()` from `src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts` on this PR head.

```json
{
  "proof": "gateway chat.send attachment parser large PNG data URL",
  "pngBytes": 1901669,
  "base64Chars": 2535560,
  "dataUrlChars": 2535582,
  "elapsedMs": 375,
  "images": 1,
  "imageMime": "image/png",
  "imageDataMatchesInput": true,
  "offloadedRefs": 0,
  "imageOrder": ["inline"],
  "message": "proof: large Control UI clipboard image",
  "result": "ok-no-RangeError"
}
```

Command:

```text
node_modules/.bin/tsx /tmp/openclaw-99213-gateway-proof.ts
```

## Regression Test Plan

- `packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts`: large canonicalization stays stack-safe for ~1.9 MB PNG payloads.
- `src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts`: MIME sniffing validates the full base64 payload and rejects invalid tails after a valid PNG prefix.
- `src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts`: Gateway attachment parsing accepts the large PNG data URL without `RangeError`.
- `ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-large-paste-99213.e2e.test.ts`: real browser Control UI paste/send path produces a `chat.send` image attachment with matching base64 content.

Validation run:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

Result: 127 passed.

Additional checks:

```text
OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs packages/media-core/src/base64.ts packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts
OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-large-paste-99213.e2e.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.non-agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-non-agents.tsbuildinfo
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 packages/media-core/src/base64.ts packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts ui/src/ui/e2e/chat-large-paste-99213.e2e.test.ts
git diff --check
```

All passed locally; GitHub CI is green on the current PR head.

## Risk / Compatibility

Risk is low and scoped to attachment/base64 parsing behavior.

- Full base64 validation is preserved.
- Malformed payloads are still rejected.
- MIME sniffing still happens from canonicalized data, only with bounded prefix decoding.
- No config, API, schema, dependency, workflow, or permission surface changes.
- The new browser E2E test is test-only and does not change runtime data model or persistence.

The main behavioral change is performance/safety: large valid image data URLs avoid stack-prone string flattening and avoid full-payload MIME decode work.

## What Was Not Tested

- No live cloud provider or external model call was made; the affected failure happens before provider delivery in Gateway attachment parsing.
- No broader large-file/PDF queue cleanup is attempted here; that belongs to the wider large-attachment tracker.
- The browser proof uses the repository's mocked Gateway E2E harness, while the parser proof exercises the real Gateway attachment parser directly.

## Canonical Fix Path / Related PRs

This PR is intended as the narrow canonical fix for `#99163`: the reported large screenshot Gateway parse/stage `RangeError`.

There is another open candidate, `#99173`, for the same issue. This PR is the stronger landing candidate because it now has:

- ClawSweeper `rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`
- `proof: sufficient`
- `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`
- full CI pass
- both real Gateway parser proof and real Control UI browser paste/send proof
- full malformed-tail validation preserved
- bounded MIME prefix decode after full validation

The broader large-attachment work remains separately tracked by `#90098` / `#92223` and should not be folded into this narrow fix.

## AI Disclosure

AI-assisted implementation and proof generation. I reviewed the diff, ran focused tests, lint/type checks, real Gateway parser proof, and real Control UI browser proof before pushing.
